label: FIXTURE ids: placeholder identifiers for the Stripe demo environment, derived with discovery.ids.fixture_uuid("stripe-demo/<name>") until Ishan's backend issues canonical ids. Replace the values, keep the keys.

derivation.ids: Every *_id value below (except endpoint ids) is discovery.ids.fixture_uuid(name) for the name listed under the matching fixture_names key: a UUIDv5 over the Shockwave namespace, so it is deterministic.
derivation.endpoint_ids: discovery.ids.endpoint_id(<contract snapshot id>, "stripe", "GET", "/v1/payment_intents/{intent}"). Endpoint record ids are snapshot-specific; cross-snapshot identity is (service_id, METHOD, path). Dependency.endpoint_id and APIChange.endpoint_id use baseline_endpoint_id: the record in the change's old (baseline) snapshot, which is also the catalog the fixture dependencies are keyed to.

provider_note: Stripe is the API provider whose authentic public contract is analyzed. Stripe is not a Shockwave customer, has not endorsed Shockwave and did not propose the simulated change; provider_org_id names the demo workspace that holds the Stripe API project, not a Stripe account.

contract_snapshots.baseline: authentic pinned Stripe OpenAPI contract (stripe/openapi 969d8c308ea6, latest/openapi.spec3.json, API 2026-09-30.endive), unmodified
contract_snapshots.proposed_simulated: SIMULATED proposed contract for the hypothetical USD amount units change (not announced by Stripe): structurally identical to the baseline; the semantics come only from demo/scenarios/stripe-payment-intent-amount-usd-major-units.manifest.json

consumer_org_note: Three fictional consumer companies, one per repository, so the demo can show that each consumer's findings stay private to that consumer and that the provider view sees only a restricted summary.
